reforms.description: The federal government announced a youth initiatives package aimed at developing entrepreneurial skills through interest-free loans.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The initiative aims to foster entrepreneurship, which can lead to job creation and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The initiative has been put into action as part of the government's efforts to support youth entrepreneurship.
reforms.importance_rationale: While it is a significant initiative, it does not represent a structural change in the innovation system.
reforms.source_quote: Youth initiatives package, including interest-free loans, announced to develop entrepreneurial skills.

reforms.description: The Canadian Jobs Strategy (CJS) was introduced to upgrade labor force skills and assist individuals in adapting to technical changes and international competition, incorporating the Innovations programme to encourage new ideas and pilot projects related to labor market concerns.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: By enhancing skills and fostering innovation, the strategy aims to improve workforce adaptability and productivity.
reforms.status_evidence: The strategy has been actively implemented to address labor market challenges.
reforms.importance_rationale: The CJS represents a major overhaul of existing training and job creation programs, significantly impacting the labor market.
reforms.source_quote: The primary objective of the Strategy, which replaces existing training and job creation programs, is to upgrade labour force skills and to assist individuals to adapt to requirements imposed by technical change and international competition.

reforms.description: The May budget provided enriched incentives for research and development to stimulate business fixed investment, particularly targeting small and medium-sized enterprises.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The incentives are designed to encourage R&D investment, which can lead to innovation and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The budget measures have been enacted and are currently in effect.
reforms.importance_rationale: While significant, the incentives are an enhancement rather than a complete overhaul of the funding system.
reforms.source_quote: Enriched incentives for research and development were provided in the May budget.
